item.title: No. 1 Penn State Wrestling Takes Down No. 2 Ohio State 36-5 to Clinch Big Ten Regular Season Title
item.description: No. 1 Penn State wrestling (14-0, 8-0) won nine of 10 bouts against No. 2 Ohio State (17-1, 7-1) to run away with a 36-5 victory on Friday night before a program-record crowd of 16,006 in the Bryce Jordan Center. The win secured the Nittany Lions' 12th Big Ten regular season title in 17 seasons under head coach Cael Sanderson and sixth in a row. item.title: No. 6 Penn State Men’s Hockey Drops Crucial Road Series to No. 2 Michigan
item.description: Penn State’s Big Ten tour continued this weekend with a pair of games against No. 2 Michigan at Yost Ice Arena. The Nittany Lions battled through regulation and overtime before falling in the shootout Friday night, then dropped the second game 6-3 to close out the series Saturday, slimming the team’s chances of a regular season conference title with just one point in Ann Arbor. item.title: Downtown State College Launches ‘Calder Way Construction Crawl’
item.description: A new initiative offers activities for kids while encouraging support of local businesses during an ongoing road construction project in State College. During Downtown State College Improvement District's "Calder Way Construction Crawl," children can get a free hard hat then collect at least five stickers from designated businesses to receive a free activity book. Accompanying parents or guardians can also enter to win a $150 Downtown Gift Card in a monthly raffle through July. Lee Anne Jeffries

item.title: Penn State’s Tessa Janecke, Team USA to Compete in Olympic Gold Medal Game
item.description: Penn State star Tessa Janecke is looking to add some hardware to her collection. item.title: Penn State Releases Date for Blue-White Weekend
item.description: Time to mark the calendars. After much anticipation, Penn State announced its annual Blue-White Weekend will take place on April 25, though no further information was provided. A social media post from the football program state more details will follow. Head coach Matt Campbell confirmed earlier this month the team would "certainly do something" this spring, though he declined to share any more details. item.title: Penn State Expected to Hire Kashif Moore as Wide Receivers Coach
item.description: Penn State's 2026 coaching staff appears to be finalized — again. The Nittany Lions are expected to hire Colorado State's Kashif Moore as their next wide receivers coach according to multiple reports, including from CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz. Moore had just been hired by the Rams in December as the wide receivers coach and passing game coordinator.
